items.name: Petrichor
items.tagline: Pressure is falling and rain is close. Wet slate-green, held low.

items.name: Golden Hour
items.tagline: Sun low, light long. The one theme where gold leads.

items.name: Nordic Fog
items.tagline: Deep cloud, no wind, no light. Lowest chroma; typography carries it.

items.name: Storm Front
items.tagline: Gusts spiking, pressure collapsing. Urgent, not alarming.

items.name: Heatwave Cruise
items.tagline: Far above the norm, air standing still. Dry heat, not tropics.

items.name: Blue Hour
items.tagline: The sun has gone and the lights aren't on. Muted violet-slate.

items.name: First Frost
items.tagline: Clear, cold and bright. The coldest blue in the system.

items.name: Sirocco
items.tagline: A warm wind from the wrong direction. Dust and kiln, nothing blue.

genres.label: Genre corridor
genres.helpText: The corridor is a vocabulary, not a mood. It never overrides the sky.
